title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-02-19

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality soundboard capture of a historic 1969 Carousel show that thrills with a monster Main Ten jam, an epic Other One, and a bizarre chant‑filled second set.
ai_review.review: The recording suffers from low vocals, hum and occasional drop‑outs typical of early SBD tapes, but the musical payoff more than compensates.  Highlights include a smoking Main Ten > Other One sequence, the first 1968 Not Fade Away, an extended Lovelight, and a 20‑minute crowd chant that makes the set uniquely psychedelic.  Listeners repeatedly note the high energy and historic importance despite the technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating across 27 detailed reviews is ~4.5; reviewers overwhelmingly praise the performance while noting consistent recording issues, leading to a strong combined score just below exceptional.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low vocal levels, hum from a bad electrical connection during Lovelight, occasional drop‑outs and overall 'horrid' SBD fidelity; however the mix is still listenable for the jam content.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual structure with a lengthy crowd chant between sets, followed by an exploratory second set of extended jams; the Main Ten > Other One suite forms the centerpiece.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as shredding and driving the Other One duet with Phil; guitar tone noted as powerful despite recording limits.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as dancing around Jerry, strong duet on The Other One; occasional yell ('Hey Pigpen…') captured during Lovelight jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) heard sporadically; organ barely audible but noted in the jam section.
